definitions: A phylum of bacteria that obtain their energy through photosynthesis, and are the only photosynthetic prokaryotes able to produce oxygen.
Often referred to as blue-green algae, though they are prokaryotic and not algae.
examples: Cyanobacteria are found in almost every terrestrial and aquatic habitat.
Some cyanobacteria can fix atmospheric nitrogen.
The bloom of cyanobacteria discoloured the lake.
